event_daxia_teach.png:
A single scene illustration for a story event in a cute cartoon roguelike card game, landscape composition.

Scene: an old martial-arts manual lying open on a stone step, its cover scuffed by cat claws, the ninja cat crouching to read the first page with wide curious eyes

The grey tabby cat ninja hero, when present, looks like this: light grey tabby fur with dark grey stripes,
white chest and paws, narrow half-lidded eyes, a NAVY BLUE ninja headband with two trailing tails,
a dark navy ninja outfit with a dark belt, long ringed tail.
Tell the story in one readable picture: clear staging, strong silhouettes, expressive faces, only what the
scene needs. It will be shown about 420 pixels wide, so no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.

not photorealistic. Warm torch-lit tower interior lighting unless the scene says otherwise.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no UI, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying - draw only the
characters and the few props the scene needs, standing on nothing.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as event_daxia_teach.png in the current directory and report the path.
